content.title: Volunteer Opportunities
content.summary: The City of Arvada offers various volunteer opportunities across multiple departments, including programs for adopting streets and trails, assisting the Arvada Police Department, and participating in community events and festivals. Residents can sign up for an email list to receive updates on volunteer opportunities and are encouraged to contact specific departments for more information. Additionally, there are opportunities to join the Community Emergency Response Team and engage with the Majestic View Nature Center.
content.body:
Are you interested in making a positive difference in your community? Consider volunteering with the City of Arvada! We utilize volunteers in several areas of the organization, but we do not coordinate volunteers through a single application process. Please contact individual departments for more information.

### City of Arvada Volunteer Email List

[Sign up for the City of Arvada email list](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/2012788/1717219/) to receive updates on City of Arvada volunteer opportunities and events.

## Adopt-a-Street

This program gives Arvada residents an opportunity to help keep roadways in their neighborhoods clean.

- Visit [Adopt a Street](/499/Adopt-a-Street) to read more about the program and apply to adopt a street.
- [Email Michele Broski](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#a2cfc0d0cdd1c9cbe2c3d0d4c3c6c38ccdd0c5), Executive Assistant or call 720-898-7692 for information about streets available for adoption.

## Adopt-a-Trail

This program focuses on keeping trails clean and maintained throughout Arvada.

- Visit [Adopt a Trail](/564/Adopt-a-Trail) to learn more about the Adopt-a-Trail program and apply to adopt a trail.
- [Email Trails Division](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#364244575f5a457657444057525718594451) or call Parks Maintenance at 720-898-7410.
- [Parks and Trails Cleanup Opportunities](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C094AACAE22AAFEC07-57203802-city#/)

## Arvada Police Department

Periodically, the Arvada Police Department (APD) requires assistance from Arvada residents to help with administrative functions and other day-to-day operations to better utilize police personnel. Please be aware that APD volunteers are subject to a background check.

- Learn more about [public safety volunteer opportunities](/714/Public-Safety-Volunteers) and apply.
- [Email Trisha Gerber](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#e591828097878097a5849793848184cb8a9782) Executive Assistant or call 720-898-6653 if you would like to have your name added to a volunteer roster for future contact.

## Boards & Commissions

Study information and make recommendations to City Council and staff in specialized areas, such as festivals, sustainability, parks, liquor licensing and others. Boards and Commissions vacancies are filled once a year December through early January.   Information is available on the [Boards and Commissions webpage](https://www.arvadaco.gov/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).

## Community Emergency Response Team (CERT)

CERT is a partnership between the Arvada CERT team, the City of Arvada and other First Responders. The next Basic Academy will be held late September and October 2025. Visit the [CERT webpage](https://www.arvadaco.gov/684/Arvada-CERT) for more information.

## Festivals

The Arvada Festivals Commission needs volunteers for various roles at City-sponsored festivals. Events include Winterfest, the Kite Festival, Arvada Summerfest and Movies Around Town.

- Visit [Arvada Festivals](/1204) to learn more and fill out the volunteer form.
- [Sign up for our newsletter](https://lp.constantcontactpages.com/su/xoa3EOH) to get the latest volunteer updates and event news.
- [Email Adelle Burton](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#ec8d8e999e988382ac8d9e9a8d888dc2839e8b), Special Events and Public Arts Manager or call 720-898-7403.

## Majestic View Nature Center

We need volunteers to help with teaching science-based school programs, hosting public hours and events, maintaining the demonstration garden, monitoring wildlife, and special projects at the Nature Center.

- Visit [Volunteering at Majestic View](/1113) to learn more and fill out the volunteer enrollment form.

## Neighborhood Leader Network

Represent your neighborhood and collaborate with other neighborhoods through this Network of dedicated leaders. For more information, visit the [Neighbors Connected webpage](https://www.arvadaco.gov/482/Neighborhood-Programs).

## Parks and Trails Cleanup

The City of Arvada Parks Department has identified key areas in our parks, trails and open space system that are regularly in need of cleanup. Individuals and groups interested in these opportunities can [volunteer through Sign Up Genius](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C094AACAE22AAFEC07-57203802-city#/).

These one-time cleanup opportunities are separate from our [Adopt-a-Trail program](http://The%20City%20of%20Arvada%20Parks%20Department%20has%20identified%20key%20areas%20in%20need%20of%20cleanup%20and%20is%20directing%20volunteers%20to%20where%20their%20efforts%20are%20most%20needed.%20%20Individuals%20and%20groups%20interested%20in%20helping%20to%20clean%20up%20designated%20parks,%20trails,%20and%20open%20spaces%20by%20picking%20up%20litter%20one%20time%20during%20a%20designated%20month%20can%20select%20a%20location%20from%20the%20signup%20list%20below.%20(See%20related%20files%20for%20maps%20of%20each%20area).).

## Ralston House

Serve as an advocate supporting children and guardians in crisis and help with special events. For more information, visit the [Ralston House website](https://www.ralstonhouse.org/volunteer).

## Reservoir Rangers

Looking to enjoy the outdoors safely while also contributing to your community? Come spend a few hours a day, a few days a week, or whatever suits your schedule at the Arvada Reservoir assisting anglers also looking to enjoy the tranquility of the lake!

- Visit the [Reservoir Rangers page](/510) to learn more and to fill out an application form.

## Snow Buddies

Shovel snow for neighbors who are physically unable to do so, cannot afford to pay for services and do not have family or friends nearby to assist. For more information, visit the [Snow Buddies webpage](https://www.arvadaco.gov/486/Snow-Buddies-Program).

## Victim Outreach Incorporated

Victim Outreach Incorporated recruits victim advocates to work in partnership with law enforcement to provide essential support to victims experiencing trauma. Training and support are provided. Visit the [Victim Outreach website](http://victimoutreach.org).
